text.drop.title: Paste your text here
text.drop.hint: Your text never leaves this browser · you can drop a file too
text.op.wordfreq.title: Word frequency
text.op.wordfreq.desc: Sorts the words you used most, by count.
text.op.text2pdf.title: Text to PDF
text.op.text2pdf.desc: Turns your text into an A4 PDF, inside the browser.
text.op.text2img.title: Text card
text.op.text2img.desc: Turns your text into a PNG image card.
text.op.charcount.title: Character count
text.op.charcount.desc: Counts spaces, sentences, paragraphs and bytes at once.
text.op.textredact.title: Redact text
text.op.textredact.desc: Finds personal data and tokens and replaces them with safe markers.
text.op.lorem.title: Dummy text
text.op.lorem.desc: Makes filler text for checking a layout.
text.op.textdiff.title: Compare texts
text.op.textdiff.desc: Shows the changed lines of two texts as additions and deletions.
text.op.unicodex.title: Find invisible characters
text.op.unicodex.desc: Finds invisible and look-alike characters (like Cyrillic a) and lets you remove them.
text.op.encdetective.title: Repair broken characters
text.op.encdetective.desc: Traces mojibake back to the original text.
text.op.checklist.title: Checklist
text.op.checklist.desc: Turns one item per line into a Markdown checklist.
text.op.listdiff.title: Compare lists
text.op.listdiff.desc: Splits two lists into shared items and items only one side has.
text.op.replace.title: Find and replace
text.op.replace.desc: Replaces every match in the text at once.
text.op.jamo.title: Hangul jamo
text.op.jamo.desc: Splits letters into jamo, joins them back, and pulls out initials.
text.op.hangulkey.title: Fix Korean/English typing
text.op.hangulkey.desc: Restores text typed with the wrong keyboard layout (2-set).
text.op.textclean.title: Tidy text
text.op.textclean.desc: Cleans up spacing, duplicates, order and notation across lines.
text.op.slug.title: Make a slug
text.op.slug.desc: Turns a title into a URL-friendly form.
text.op.case.title: Change naming case
text.op.case.desc: Converts a name into the code casing you want.
text.op.linebreak.title: Fix line breaks
text.op.linebreak.desc: Joins copied text back together, or rewraps it to a readable width.
